title: Non-payment of Full Sum of Salary Claims of Non-Malaysian Work Permit Holders
what_it_is: Non-payment of Full Sum of Salary Claims of Non-Malaysian Work Permit Holders

sections.label: Salary claims and security bonds
sections.summary: Labour Court and Employment Claims Tribunals issued about 130 money orders yearly for non-Malaysian Work Permit holders' salary claims, with most workers fully paid.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: In the last five years, the Labour Court and the Employment Claims Tribunals issued an average of 130 money orders per year for salary claims involving non-Malaysian Work Permit holders.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: In most cases, affected workers received full payments from their employers or settlement payments through insurers.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: In about 10% of the cases, the Migrant Workers’ Centre stepped in to provide assistance to the workers via the Migrant Workers’ Assistance Fund (MWAF).

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: In the last five years, the Government forfeited an average of 150 SBs annually for workers with salary claims due to reasons, such as non-payment of salary or failure to repatriate the workers.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: MWAF is funded through donations from the public, which is matched by Government funding, rather than through forfeiture of SBs, which can vary greatly from year to year.

sections.label: Forfeited bonds and MWAF assistance
sections.summary: If insurance does not cover, the security bond is forfeited and workers are assisted through MWAF, which supplements the last 10% who do not get payments.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: If the insurance does not cover, the SB gets forfeited, and the workers get assisted through MWAF.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: So, that gets deployed to supplement for the last 10%, for example, who do not get payments.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: So, the majority of those receiving orders actually get full payments.
